dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About those unsettling omens I keep seeing...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: No matter what the cause may be, all we can do is pray.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I had some adventurers help me collect some Cecilia buds to give everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: These flowers grow on top of cliffs, whisked by the Mondstadt winds...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Perhaps these flowers that emanate the essence of Barbatos can bring some peace of mind to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Here, please take some. May Barbatos shine upon Mondstadt.
